headline: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI agent for large code bases, while top AI researchers leave Google to start their own venture
tldr: Today's AI news is marked by significant launches and departures. Meta introduced Muse Code, an AI agent designed to handle complex coding tasks. Meanwhile, top AI researchers, including Jeff Dean, are leaving Google to launch their own startup focused on using AI for scientific discovery. Other notable developments include Anthropic hiring a team for custom AI chip design and MacPaw partnering with Liquid AI for on-device inference. These advancements underscore the rapid evolution of the AI landscape, with both new technologies and shifting personnel dynamics playing crucial roles.
